taiwan-legal-db.title: Taiwan Legal Database
taiwan-legal-db.description: Stdio MCP server exposing twelve read-only tools over Taiwan's judicial judgment portal (judgment.judicial.gov.tw), National Regulation Database (law.moj.gov.tw), Constitutional Court records (cons.judicial.gov.tw), the Judicial Yuan law database (legal.judicial.gov.tw) and ministries' official interpretation systems. Source: github.com/lawchat-oss/mcp-taiwan-legal-db.
